content: WASM vs JS JIT for tight numeric loops: modern V8/JSC JIT closes most of the gap on typed-array-only loops with no allocation, boxing, or polymorphism; WASM wins mainly on predictable memory layout, SIMD, and avoiding GC pauses, with real advantage growing as computation complexity and array size increase. For a simple daily-rebalance loop over Float64Array, plain JS in a Worker is competitive; WASM+SIMD pulls ahead once vectorized (4-8x on tight arithmetic loops).
